## Fish Analysis

load tidyverse and dataset

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

fish_data <- read_csv("../data/Gaeta_etal_CLC_data.csv")

head(fish_data)
```

Summary statistics for fish scale length

```{r}
min_max_length <- fish_data |> 
  summarize(min_scale_length = min(scalelength, na.rm = T),
            max_scale_length = max(scalelength, na.rm = T),
            mean_scale_length = mean(scalelength, na.rm = T))

```

```{r}
fish_data_clean <- filter(fish_data, scalelength >= 1)

fish_data_clean

write_csv(fish_data_cleaned, "../clean_data/Gaeta_etal_CLC_data_cleaned.csv"
                          
```
